title: In availability zone “flare3”, for the top 10 VM states ranked by the total
question: In availability zone “flare3”, for the top 10 VM states ranked by the total number of matching INSTANCE_EXTRA records, show each VM state’s distinct instance count, total matching INSTANCE_EXTRA record count, total sum of INSTANCE_EXTRA IDs, and (from the per-instance utilization analysis) the total instances in that VM state, the average instances-per-state benchmark, and the utilization category (HIGH_UTILIZATION/LOW_UTILIZATION/AVERAGE_UTILIZATION). Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each VM state as 'HIGH_UTILIZATION' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_UTILIZATION' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_UTILIZATION'.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    i.vm_state,
    i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
    ie.id AS instance_extra_id
  FROM instances i
  LEFT JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
),
vm_state_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    vm_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT instance_uuid) AS distinct_instance_count,
    COUNT(instance_extra_id) AS total_matching_instance_extra_record_count,
    SUM(instance_extra_id) AS total_sum_instance_extra_ids,
    COUNT(DISTINCT instance_uuid) AS total_instances_in_vm_state
  FROM base
  GROUP BY vm_state
),
avg_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_instances_in_vm_state * 1.0) AS avg_instances_per_state
  FROM vm_state_stats
)
SELECT 
  v.vm_state,
  v.distinct_instance_count,
  v.total_matching_instance_extra_record_count,
  v.total_sum_instance_extra_ids,
  v.total_instances_in_vm_state,
  a.avg_instances_per_state AS average_instances_per_state_benchmark,
  CASE 
    WHEN v.total_instances_in_vm_state >= a.avg_instances_per_state * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_UTILIZATION'
    WHEN v.total_instances_in_vm_state <= a.avg_instances_per_state * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_UTILIZATION'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE_UTILIZATION'
  END AS utilization_category
FROM vm_state_stats v
CROSS JOIN avg_benchmark a
ORDER BY v.total_matching_instance_extra_record_count DESC
LIMIT 10
